# SLE100 Series


Advanced Energy's SLE100 series AC-DC power adapters deliver up to 100 W output with USB-C PD3.0 fast-charging capability. Featuring GaN-based technology, medical and ITE safety approvals, and compliance with U.S.


### SLE100 Series | 100 W GaN Based USB-C PD3.0 with Level VII Compliance


Nov 17, 2026


Advanced Energy's SLE100 series AC-DC power adapters deliver up to 100 W output with USB-C PD3.0 fast-charging capability. Featuring GaN-based technology, medical and ITE safety approvals, and compliance with U.S. Department of Energy Level VII efficiency standards, the SLE100 provides a ready-to-deploy power solution for regulated medical and industrial applications. It offers dual MOPP isolation, Type BF suitability, and support for PD3.0, QC3.0, and PPS charging protocols. Learn more: https://bit.ly/3X9vt99
